mapper.select: SELECT BUSINESS_WORKTYPE_NO, WORKTYPE_CATEGORY, EMPLOYER_NO FROM BUSINESS_WORKTYPE b JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON (b.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo}
SELECT BUSINESS_WORKTYPE_NO, bw.WORKTYPE_NO, WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM BUSINESS_WORKTYPE bw JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON(bw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "RECRUITMENT" WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo}

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE FROM RECRUITMENT r JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND r.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo} ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "RECRUITMENT" r JOIN "EMPLOYER" e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND r.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo}
AND RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND ( RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' )

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE FROM RECRUITMENT r JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND r.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo}
AND RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND ( RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' )
ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC
SELECT SUBSTR(WORKTYPE_NO, 1, 2) AS "workTypeNo", SUBSTR(WORKTYPE_CATEGORY, 1, INSTR(WORKTYPE_CATEGORY, '전체')-2) AS "majorCategoryName" FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE WHERE WORKTYPE_NO LIKE '__00'
SELECT WORKTYPE_NO AS "workTypeNo", WORKTYPE_CATEGORY AS "worktypeCategory" FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE WHERE WORKTYPE_NO LIKE #{workTypeNo}||'__' AND WORKTYPE_NO NOT LIKE '__00'
